# East Coast AC & Heating Ltd

> Licensed 24/7 emergency HVAC serving Surrey and the entire Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley, British Columbia, Canada. Phone: 778-344-4938. Based at 7156 144 St, Unit 18, Surrey, BC. Handle: eastcoastacbc.

East Coast AC & Heating Ltd is a Surrey-based HVAC / plumbing-heating contractor offering 24/7 emergency heating and cooling, furnace and AC repair, heat pumps, boilers, ductless mini-splits, maintenance, thermostats, and furnace-safety inspections. Contact form only until a public number is live. No invented prices or review counts.

## Services
- [24/7 Emergency HVAC](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/emergency-hvac.html): When the furnace dies on a cold night or the AC fails in a heat wave, you need a real HVAC crew â€” not an answering service.
- [Furnace Repair & Install](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/furnace-repair.html): From a furnace that will not ignite to a full replacement, we service gas furnaces in Surrey homes and across the Lower Mainland â€” quoted before we start.
- [AC Repair & Install](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/ac-repair.html): When the AC dies in a Lower Mainland heat wave, we diagnose, repair, or install cooling so the house is livable again.
- [Heat Pumps](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/heat-pumps.html): A properly sized heat pump heats and cools efficiently through most Lower Mainland weather.
- [Boilers](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/boilers.html): Hydronic heat is quiet and even when it is running right.
- [Ductless Mini-Splits](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/ductless-mini-split.html): No ducts? A ductless mini-split can heat and cool a suite, addition, or whole small home without ripping out walls for ductwork.
- [Maintenance](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/hvac-maintenance.html): A fall furnace clean-and-check and a spring cooling check catch a lot of no-heat and no-cool calls before they become emergencies.
- [Thermostats](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/thermostats.html): A dead, confusing, or mismatched thermostat can look like a failed furnace.
- [Frozen Pipes & No Heat](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/frozen-pipes.html): When the heat fails in a cold snap, pipes are next.
- [Furnace Smells & CO Safety](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/furnace-safety.html): A strange smell from the furnace is not something to 'wait until Monday.
- [Commercial HVAC](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/commercial-hvac.html): When a shop or office loses heat or cooling, the business stops.
- [Strata HVAC](https://eastcoastheating.ca/services/strata-hvac.html): Townhomes, condos, and rental suites have different HVAC access rules.

- [Heat Pumps in the Lower Mainland: When They Make Sense](https://eastcoastheating.ca/blog/heat-pumps-lower-mainland.html): A straight explanation of ducted vs ductless heat pumps for coastal BC weather â€” no rebate amounts we cannot verify.
- [Strange Smell from the Furnace: Dust, Filter, or Get Out](https://eastcoastheating.ca/blog/strange-furnace-smells.html): How to tell a dusty first-start smell from a furnace that should be shut down â€” including carbon monoxide caution.
- [Why Fall Furnace and Spring AC Checks Matter in BC](https://eastcoastheating.ca/blog/hvac-maintenance-fall-spring.html): What a real maintenance visit includes, and why the first cold Friday night is the wrong time to find a failed igniter.
